editorial:
Imagine you are a successful dentist with a perfect life, only to have it all crash down because of one bad decision. That is exactly what happens to the main character when a beautiful patient comes into his office. She uses her charms to trick him into giving her prescription drugs, but things quickly spiral out of control. The vibe is a mix of a dark comedy and a tense crime story, making you feel the panic as the dentist goes from a trusted doctor to a primary murder suspect. It is a wild ride that shows how a little bit of flirting can lead to a total nightmare.

You will really enjoy how the movie keeps you guessing with its twists and turns. The acting is solid, and the pacing moves fast enough that you will not get bored. While some of the plot points feel a bit convenient, the fun energy makes up for it. If you love movies where a normal person gets in way over their head, you should definitely give this a try.
endingExplained: In the end, you find out that the patient was actually playing a long game to frame the dentist for her own fake death. She wanted his money and a fresh start. However, the dentist manages to flip the script on her. He uses his medical knowledge to trick her back, eventually proving her guilt to the police. The movie wraps up with the bad guys getting caught and the dentist finally clearing his name.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves movies about scams and unexpected twists.
